usage.title: Usage
usage.note: Token usage comes from the Realtime API usage payload; cost is a front-end estimate. Your actual bill is based on the provider console.
usage.noteChat: Token usage is estimated on the front-end from input/output text and the image-tiling rule; cost is a front-end estimate. Your actual bill is based on the provider console.
usage.resolutionOptimization: Lower the resolution to save even more on image cost
usage.billUsageAuthoritative: Token usage is authoritative from the Realtime API; cost is a front-end estimate using gpt-realtime pricing.
usage.billUsageEstimated: Token usage is estimated on the front-end from input/output text and the image-tiling rule; cost is a front-end estimate using Chat Completions pricing.
usage.billVerifyProvider: Your actual bill is based on the provider console. Treat the figure above as a reference, and verify against your provider's invoice before relying on it.
usage.trendChart: Cumulative cost line and per-turn input token bars
usage.trendChartLegend: bars: input tokens · line: cumulative cost
usage.priceNote: Prices shown are the per-1M-token rates used for the in-app cost estimate; billing truth lives in the provider console.
usage.budgetGuardUnset: No budget set. Set a monthly amount to enable the cross-session cost guardrail.
usage.budgetWarn: Used {{pct}}% of the monthly budget — approaching the limit.
usage.budgetForecastRemaining: Extrapolated from current month's trend ({{days}} days left).
usage.forecastEmpty: No usage trend data to extrapolate yet.
usage.forecastChart: Cumulative cost line with dashed extrapolation to the forecast end
usage.forecastInsufficient: Need at least {{count}} usage points to extrapolate a trend.
usage.budgetWarning: You've used 80% of your session budget. Consider stopping soon to avoid overspending.
usage.budgetExceeded: Your session has reached its spending budget. Further calls will keep accruing cost.
usage.budgetInvalid: Enter a positive number (USD) or leave blank to clear.
usage.cockpitForecastNote: Linear extrapolation over {{count}} sessions for {{days}} days.
usage.cockpitForecastInsufficient: At least {{count}} session costs are needed to extrapolate.
usage.cockpitMonthForecastInsufficient: No per-day spend data yet to project the month-end spend.
usage.calibrationEmpty: Record the actual billed amount from the provider console to compare against the front-end estimate in real time.
usage.calibrationNeedsCalibration: Aggregate delta exceeds {{threshold}}%; consider revising the estimated unit prices.
usage.calibrationWithinTolerance: Delta is within an acceptable range; no unit-price revision needed.

status.chatSpeechUnsupported: Your browser does not support local recording. Please use the keyboard instead.
status.chatSpeechNeedAccess: Please grant camera and microphone access before using voice input.
status.continuousListening: Continuous chat is listening; it will transcribe automatically when you finish.
status.continuousTranscribing: Continuous chat is transcribing your voice via Worker.
status.continuousWaiting: Continuous chat is waiting for the model to answer.
status.continuousSpeaking: Reading the answer aloud; will resume listening when done.
status.recordingStop: Recording. Tap stop when you finish to transcribe.
status.autoSendVoice: Recording is transcribed, then sent to Chat automatically.
status.reviewVoice: Recording is transcribed and filled into the input box for your review.
status.providerSending: Sending request to Chat Completions over HTTP
status.providerChat: Using Chat Completions: no Realtime/WebRTC session needed
status.providerWaitingCreate: Waiting for Worker to create a session
status.pttRealtimeHint: Hold-to-talk is only for Realtime mode; in Chat mode use the voice input or keyboard on the right.
status.pttHoldHint: Hold to capture microphone audio; release to submit to the Realtime model.
status.costProviderChatDetail: Calls /v1/chat/completions over HTTP; compatible with common API gateways
status.costProviderRealtimeDetail: Direct WebRTC Realtime connection, ideal for low-latency voice
status.costVisionChatDetail: Sends only the current frame per question
status.costVisionIntervalDetail: Sends sampled JPEG only; no continuous raw video upload
status.costSessionDetail: Limits each Realtime session to avoid idle cost
status.costIdleDetail: Warns after {{count}}s; disconnects automatically after long inactivity
status.costBudgetDetail: Worker sets a max token count for model output
status.costModeChatDetail: Chat read-aloud is done by the browser; no audio tokens produced
status.costModeTextOnlyDetail: Requests text output only, reducing audio tokens
status.costModeBothDetail: Requests both voice and text replies
status.costKeyDetail: Permanent key is stored only in Worker environment variables
status.costTurnChatDetail: Browser records short audio; Worker transcribes before sending the Chat request
status.costTurnPttDetail: Hold the button to capture mic; release to submit
status.costTurnVadDetail: Server-side VAD detects when the user stops speaking
status.costMicChatDetail: Uploads a short recording only when asking by voice
status.costMicMutedDetail: No microphone audio is currently sent
status.costMicRealtimeDetail: Audio is sent through the Realtime session
status.costSessionChatDetail: Chat Completions does not keep a WebRTC long connection
status.costFrameDetail: Auto sampling skips frames with very little change
